maddeler.e:
نفتعل (form VIII)
# نَفْتَعِلُ (naftaʕilu) /naf.ta.ʕi.lu/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of اِفْتَعَلَ (iftaʕala)
# نُفْتَعَلُ (nuftaʕalu) /nuf.ta.ʕa.lu/: first-person plural non-past passive indicative of اِفْتَعَلَ (iftaʕala)
# نَفْتَعِلَ (naftaʕila) /naf.ta.ʕi.la/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of اِفْتَعَلَ (iftaʕala)
# نُفْتَعَلَ (nuftaʕala) /nuf.ta.ʕa.la/:
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
